categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: smart water services and rare earth resource recycling. The smart water segment includes the development, production, and sales of various water meters (mechanical, smart, IoT-enabled), water management software, and integrated water service solutions. The rare earth segment focuses on recycling and processing rare earth materials, particularly from NdFeB magnet waste and molten salt slag, producing rare earth oxides such as praseodymium-neodymium oxide.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including NB-IoT communication, 5G, ultrasonic and electromagnetic sensing for smart water meters. It employs acid and combined alkali-to-acid extraction processes for efficient rare earth recycling with a product yield of up to 96%. The smart water production has transitioned to a lean, automated 5G digital factory with over 95% automation, integrating digital twin, AI, and edge computing technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal water supply companies, water utilities, and industrial clients requiring water metering and management solutions. The rare earth products are sold mainly to metal processing and permanent magnet manufacturers. The company serves domestic markets extensively across China and exports smart water meters to over 60 countries including Europe, Southeast Asia, Africa, Oceania, and South America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major sales regions including Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest. It has a growing international presence with exports to multiple continents. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in the Jiangxi Province high-tech industrial park.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the water metering and rare earth recycling supply chains. It manufactures finished smart water meters and water management systems, and processes rare earth waste materials into refined oxides for downstream magnet manufacturers. It also provides integrated water service solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on dual growth engines: upgrading the water segment with smart metering, energy-saving, and premium water supply solutions, and expanding the rare earth recycling segment with enhanced capacity and technology. R&D priorities include advancing IoT water meter technologies, 5G-enabled multi-sensing meters, and improving rare earth extraction efficiency. The company emphasizes innovation, digital transformation, and sustainability in its R&D efforts.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of water meters and rare earth oxides. Additional income comes from software and SaaS water management platforms, water service operations, and value-added data services. The company also earns from leasing assets and investment income related to its financial assets and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the earliest and leading smart water meter manufacturers and smart water service providers in China, holding significant market share and brand recognition. Its rare earth recycling subsidiary is among the few with advanced molten salt slag processing capabilities, securing a competitive edge in the niche market. The industry is competitive with many players, but the company’s integrated hardware-software solutions and patented technologies provide strong barriers to entry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.47 billion, a 35.5% decline from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 63.77 million, down 73.4%. The decline was mainly due to rare earth price drops and operational challenges in the rare earth segment. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 2.93 billion with a net asset value of RMB 2.5 billion. Despite short-term setbacks, the company is investing in digital transformation and capacity expansion to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive smart water metering solutions combining advanced hardware (NB-IoT, 5G, ultrasonic, electromagnetic meters) with integrated cloud-based water management platforms, enabling precise measurement, leak detection, and operational efficiency for water utilities. Its rare earth recycling business offers high product yield and unique molten salt slag processing technology, addressing resource scarcity and environmental sustainability. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and digital factory automation differentiate it in both sectors.
